headline: Contested Sectors Renew Their Advance
war_summary: Since the last edition, the ledger has grown busier on several unsettled fronts. Weathered Expanse now records 38 strategic-base events in 24 hours, including 11 in the latest two-hour watch; control stands at three Warden, five Colonial, and one neutral base, while enlistments and Colonial casualties are rising. Stlican Shelf remains sharply contested at 46 daily events, with two fresh changes and ownership split five Warden to four Colonial. Godcrofts has added six events since the previous report and now shows 19 for the day, its nine bases divided one Warden to eight Colonial. Stonecradle has likewise advanced to 24 daily events, including three recent changes, with five Warden and four Colonial bases. Linn’s Mercy retains nine daily events and a seven-to-four Warden lead, though fighting and enlistments remain active. Deadlands has held at 18 daily events, with five changes in six hours; its eleven bases remain Colonial-held as the latest casualty rates cool. Callahan’s Passage has also entered the watch with five daily events and sharply accelerating enlistments, despite no movement in the latest two hours.
